errors.quote: The transform has $\ell$ rounds, and each round applies the two-point averaging and differencing step to one address bit of every axis.
errors.problem: Short axes have only l-1 address bits. The first round (named position h=l-1) acts on the long axes only, so not every round touches every axis. The paper processes h=l-1 "on the long axes, if there are any".

errors.quote: Every later round is then a single layer.
errors.problem: Only the qK chunk rounds are single layers. Up to b+1 rounds on prefix slots process their bits individually, as the page itself says later and as the paper does.

errors.quote: There are $qK$ rounds on chunk bits and $b+1$ on prefix bits, $\ell$ in all.
errors.problem: This holds only when at least one axis is long. If all axes are short, there are b prefix rounds and l-1 rounds in total. The paper says "at most b+1" prefix rounds and "at most l rounds"; the page's later "the l rounds" in the error section has the same imprecision.

errors.quote: Here $K^{\tau-1}<1$ and $d^{\lambda'}<d$ are the savings over $D\ell$ passes.
errors.problem: The lemma permits K=1 (1<=K=floor(d^c)), and then K^{tau-1}=1. The strict inequality needs K>=2.
